evals.prompt: How should I structure state in my React app? We keep duplicating API data into local state
evals.expected_output: Classifies state into server state (owned by a fetching/cache layer), shared client state (context or small store), and local state, and rules out duplicating API data into local state as a second source of truth.

evals.prompt: Our SPA is slow to load and everything is client-rendered. What is our rendering strategy?
evals.expected_output: Maps requirements (SEO needs, per-user content, auth-gated app) to a rendering strategy such as static generation, server rendering, or hybrid, and recommends measuring before optimizing.
